about: ClamAV detections and YARA-X matches reviewed and found not to be malicious, by scan (ClamAV or YARA-X), signature or rule name and file. The Malware scan workflow fails on any detection not listed here, and on any entry for its scan that no longer matches a detection. In a file, `*` matches within one path segment. Keep each reason specific: say what the file is and why the signature fires on it, and re-review the entry when the file changes.
